title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1983-04-15
source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:32780), Recording Info: set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k)Set 2: SBD -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k)Transfer Info:Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC and Audience (shnid:94282), Recording Info: (FOB) Audio Technica Mics -> Cassette Master (Sony D6/Maxell UDXL-II/Dolby B); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Namamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16, Recorded and Transfered By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording with airy, clear sound that showcases a standout Space and a grooving Shakedown.
ai_review.review: The matrix source delivers a clean, spacious mix that captures the venue’s ambience beautifully. Fans highlight an especially powerful Space and a fun‑filled Shakedown as the show’s high points, making this performance one of the more memorable early‑’80s dates. Overall the recording is listenable from start to finish with no reported flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers praise both the musical performance and the sound quality; standout Space and Shakedown indicate a strong show, while the matrix mix is described as airy and great.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, airy mix that captures venue ambience; no dropout or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Relaxed first half leading into an expansive second set where Space provides a high‑energy peak and Shakedown keeps the groove rolling.

band_member_comments.Drums: Reviewer appreciated the drum sequences, noting they were nicely dosed and added to the overall vibe.
